purpose: The OUTPUT config. What the word-raw report shows is a config choice, not code. report.py is an interpreter that renders from these settings — the same principle as the rules.

boundary.config holds: WHAT the report shows — how many sample verses, whether the verse text appears, which fields per section.
boundary.code holds: HOW a section is rendered (a markdown table) — a report shape, a fact, not a choice.

report.sample_verses.use: how many sample verses to show the span layer for

report.show_verse_text.use: show the verse's plain text above its spans

report.strong_fields.use: which columns the L1->L2 strong table shows

report.span_fields.use: which columns the span table shows
